errors.noPageToFill: There is no page to fill.

errors.noLoginForm: No login form was found on this page.

errors.nothingBack: Nothing came back from that server.

errors.unknownServer: That host is not on the list any more.

menu.fill: Fill the login for this site

save.nameIt: Give it a name so you can find it again.
save.webPage: The address has to be a web page.
save.nothingYet: Add a username or a password: there is nothing to save yet.

unlock.noKeys: This browser is no longer holding your vault keys. Ask Polaris to let it in again.
unlock.noDerivation: This copy of the extension could not run your vault's key derivation. Updating it is what fixes that.
unlock.wrongPassword: That password did not open the vault.

generator.nothing: Nothing can be made of that.
generator.oneStaysOn: At least one kind has to stay on
generator.avoidHint: Leave out 0 and O, 1, l and I
generator.useHint: Put it straight into a new login

shell.greeting: {part, select, night {Good night} morning {Good morning} afternoon {Good afternoon} other {Good evening}}{hasName, select, yes {, {name}} other {}}

update.store: Version {version} is out. Your browser installs it once the store has reviewed it, so there is nothing to do here.
update.byHand: Version {version} is out. This copy was loaded by hand, so it has to be loaded again the same way. <link>{where, select, polaris {The steps are on your Polaris} other {See what changed}}</link>.
update.auto: Version {version} is out. This copy updates itself within a few hours.
update.ready: Version {version} is installed. It starts by itself once the vault is locked and this is closed.
update.startNowHint: Restarts the extension, so you sign in to the vault again.
update.runOnce: Version {version} is out. Run this once in {shell} and this copy updates itself from then on:

connect.hint: The address you open the dashboard at.
connect.permission: The browser will ask whether this extension may talk to that address. It is the only one it ever reads.

link.denied: That was turned down in Polaris.
link.expired: That request ran out. Ask again.
link.approveIn: Approve this in the tab that opened. The code there should read:
link.nothingUntil: Nothing is connected until somebody signed in to Polaris says yes. You can close this; it carries on without it.
link.title: Connect this browser
link.hint: A tab opens on your Polaris and you approve it there. The connection appears under Sessions, and you can end it from there at any time.

popup.unreachable: Polaris can't be reached right now. You are still signed in, and the vault tries again every minute.

signIn.nothingUntil: Nothing is handed over until somebody with the vault open says yes. You can close this; it carries on without it.
signIn.noVault: This account does not have a vault on {host}, so there are no logins to fill here.
signIn.hint: Approving happens on your dashboard, with your vault open. The key is handed over sealed, so only this extension can open it - and it is tied to this connection, so disconnecting the browser closes the vault with it.

unlock.title: Vault locked
unlock.fromPolaris: Let me in from Polaris instead

sites.noEveryPermission: Without permission for every site, Polaris stays where you turned it on.
sites.reloadOpen: Pages already open keep it until you reload them.
sites.everywhereOff: Show Polaris under login boxes on every site.
sites.onlySomeHint: Only show Polaris on the sites you turn it on for
sites.everyHint: Offer your logins and codes under the box on every site, like a password manager
sites.noSitePermission: Without permission for this site, nothing can be drawn on it.
sites.reloadPage: The mark goes when you reload the page.
sites.notHereHint: Stop drawing anything inside this site's pages
sites.showHereHint: Show the fill mark, the generator and the save offer on this site

clipboard.refused: The browser refused the clipboard. Try again.
clipboard.copied: Copied. Cleared in {seconds} seconds if this stays open.

change.onSiteToo: Change it on the site too, or you will be locked out of it.

saveLogin.forPage: Save a login for this page
saveLogin.name: Name

inline.noCodes: Nothing here carries a one-time code.
inline.makePasswordDetail: A strong one, for both password boxes
inline.breachOne: This password has appeared in a data breach. Pick a different one.
inline.breachMany: This password has appeared in {count} breaches. Pick a different one.

servers.accounts: {count, plural, =0 {Not signed in} one {# account} other {# accounts}}
servers.already: That host is already on the list.
servers.removeSignsOut: {count, plural, one {The account signed in on it here is signed out and this browser is disconnected from it.} other {The # accounts signed in on it here are signed out and this browser is disconnected from them.}}
